facts.fact: DOOH ad spending in Canada is projected to reach $467 million USD in 2025 and grow at a CAGR of 5.34%, reaching $605 million USD by 2030 (Statista projection, as cited by StackAdapt).
facts.quote: [DOOH ad spending in Canada](https://www.statista.com/outlook/amo/advertising/out-of-home-advertising/digital-out-of-home-advertising/canada) is projected to reach $467 million USD in 2025 and grow at a CAGR of 5.34%, reaching $605 million USD by 2030.

facts.fact: The Australian DOOH market is expected to expand at a CAGR of 5.79% to reach $690 million USD by 2030 (Statista projection).

facts.fact: DOOH ad spending in the UK is projected to reach $1.62 billion USD by the end of the decade at a CAGR of 6.54% (Statista projection).
facts.quote: with a CAGR of 6.54% bringing total market volume to $1.62 billion USD by the end of the decade.

facts.fact: In an OAAA and The Harris Poll study, 73% of consumers view DOOH ads favourably, ranking them higher than television/video (50%), social media (48%), online (37%), audio (32%), and print (31%).
facts.quote: 73% of consumers view DOOH ads favourably, ranking them higher than other forms of media

facts.fact: In an OAAA and The Harris Poll study, 76% of viewers took action after seeing a DOOH ad.
facts.quote: The same study found that 76% of viewers took action after seeing a DOOH ad.

facts.fact: In the OAAA and Harris Poll study, 38% of viewers who took action after a DOOH ad watched a video, 36% went to a restaurant, 29% visited a store, 30% purchased in store, and 30% talked about the brand.
facts.quote: The most common responses included watching a video (38%), going to a restaurant (36%), visiting a store (29%), purchasing a product in store (30%)

facts.fact: In the OAAA and Harris Poll study, 80% of consumers were more likely to take action when DOOH ads were seen as funny, clever, creative, or visually interesting.
facts.quote: When ads were seen as funny, clever, creative, or visually interesting, 80% of consumers were more likely to take action.

facts.fact: In the OAAA and Harris Poll study, 51% of consumers who noticed a DOOH ad providing directions to a nearby store or restaurant visited the business, and 93% completed a purchase.
facts.quote: 51% of consumers who noticed a DOOH ad providing directions to a nearby store or restaurant visited the business, and 93% completed a purchase.

facts.fact: In the OAAA and Harris Poll study, over 80% of respondents said DOOH ads promoting deals on groceries, restaurants, and other retail categories were useful and encouraged them to buy.
facts.quote: Over 80% of respondents said DOOH ads promoting deals on groceries, restaurants, and other retail categories were useful and encouraged them to buy.

facts.fact: 81% of viewers found DOOH ads that adjust creative in real time based on weather conditions helpful and relevant.
facts.quote: 81% of viewers found DOOH ads that adjust creative in real time based on [weather conditions](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/weather-targeting) helpful and relevant.

facts.fact: In a 2024 OAAA survey, 74% of mobile device users took action on their phones after seeing a DOOH ad, including online searches about advertisers (44%), visiting websites (38%), and visiting social media pages (30%).
facts.quote: According to a [2024 survey](https://oaaa.org/news/new-study-finds-digital-out-of-home-advertising-surpasses-other-media-in-driving-favorability-and-action-among-consumers/), 74% of mobile device users took action on their phones after seeing a DOOH ad.

facts.fact: In an OAAA and Harris Poll study, 47% of consumers searched for social media handles featured on OOH ads, while 40% shared related content online.
facts.quote: 47% of consumers searched for social media handles featured on OOH ads, while 40% shared related content online.

facts.fact: In a US study, nearly six in 10 US adults recalled recently seeing an OOH ad promoting a major sporting event, and 90% of those took a real-world action.
facts.quote: nearly [six in 10 US adults](https://oaaa.org/news/ooh-powers-sports-marketing-playbook-majority-of-sports-fans-recall-seeing-out-of-home-ads-most-take-action/) recall recently seeing an OOH ad promoting a major sporting event. Of those, 90% took a real-world action

facts.fact: In a US study, 99% of fans who attended a game after seeing an OOH ad spent money locally.
facts.quote: 99% of fans who attended a game after seeing an OOH ad spent money locally

facts.fact: A KPMG report found that OOH advertising emits just 0.25g of CO₂ per impression (as cited by StackAdapt via WARC).
facts.quote: A recent report from KPMG found that [OOH advertising emits just 0.25g of CO₂ per impression](https://www.warc.com/content/feed/ooh-makes-a-sustainability-play/en-GB/9349)

facts.fact: In-store retail media ad spending is projected to represent nearly one-fifth of total ad spend by 2027 and account for 55.9% of DOOH's total growth between 2025 and 2029 (eMarketer forecast).
facts.quote: account for 55.9% of DOOH’s total growth between 2025 and 2029.

facts.fact: DOOH is forecasted to represent 23% of in-store retail media ad spending by 2028 (EMARKETER).
facts.quote: DOOH is forecasted to represent 23% of in-store retail media ad spending by 2028.
